dct_description_sm: This work was done under ArcticNet project 2.4, Instability of Coastal Landscapes in Arctic Communities and Regions<http://www.arcticnet.ulaval.ca/research/summary.php?project_id=44> (http://www.arcticnet.ulaval.ca/research/iris_2.php), and the C-Change ICURA project, Managing Adaptation to Environmental Change in Coastal Communities: Canada and the Caribbean (http://www.coastalchange.ca/). The objective of this activity is to support sustainable development, including climate-change adaptation, in the City of Iqaluit by identifying and, where possible, quantifying coastal ice, wave, and flooding hazards and their potential impacts on waterfront infrastructure.
dct_title_s: Coastal geoscience data in Koojesse Inlet, Nunavut.
